206-2023-3755-4518.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

579-5137-6006.description:
Activate Morphling by tapping it, adding {U}{U} due to Mana Reflection
Activate Morphling by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3169-3249-4289--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3169-3249-4289--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Cryptolith Rite by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Cryptolith Rite by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Genesis Chamber triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1479-2841-3534-8100.easyPrerequisites:
(optional)You control an Elf or have an Elf card in hand. Your life total is 2 or higher.
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Elven Passage.
1479-2841-3534-8100.notablePrerequisites: You control seven or more lands with different names.
1479-2841-3534-8100.description:
Fetch a land using Elven Passage.
When the fetched land enters, Field of the Dead and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Field of the Dead trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Field of the Dead trigger from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Field of the Dead triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

4067-5078-5243.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping the mana-producing permanent.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Repeat.

1325-3000-5670.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
1325-3000-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Kheru Bloodsucker triggers, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token and a creature token.
Repeat.

2060-4770-7889.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Dancing from Dark to Dawn's first ability triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion spell. When it enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{W}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

2122-2445-7737.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
Stark's Ingenuity triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Mindless Automaton due to Branching Evolution
Repeat.

5078-6766-7692.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

2724-3080-4608-6433.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five enchantments.
2724-3080-4608-6433.description:
Cast Exchange of Words by paying {1}{U}{U}.
When Exchange of Words enters, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of itself and Wormfang Manta.
Activate Flickerform by paying {2}{W}{W}, exiling and returning (at end step) itself and Exchange of Words.
When Exchange of Words leaves the battlefield, its ability from Wormfang Manta's textbox triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
When Exchange of Words enters, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of itself and Wormfang Manta.
Repeat from step 3 each turn.

647-2713-3094-4659-7344.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in your graveyard.
647-2713-3094-4659-7344.description:
Cast Brilliance Unleashed by paying {4}{U}{R}. Choose its second mode, targeting any artifact card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {1} due to Zirda and tapping it, targeting Brilliance Unleashed.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lithoform Engine, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Lithoform Engine ability, copying Brilliance Unleashed, targeting Lithoform Engine.
Resolve the copy of Brilliance Unleashed, returning Lithoform Engine from your graveyard to the battlefield as a 3/3 Robot artifact creature.
Repeat from step 2.

222-527-2438-4742.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-2438-4742.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Carrion Feeder twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

2781-3817-6798.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying its mana cost.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Sister Hospitaller
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian ability, blinking Sister Hospitaller
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1659-5147-7084.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Seed the Land triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

1358-1978-4002.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
1358-1978-4002.description:
Animate Sceptre of Eternal Glory using Sydri.
Activate Sceptre of Eternal Glory by tapping it, adding three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Sceptre of Eternal Glory.
Repeat from step 2.

1492-4195-4311-4574.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
1492-4195-4311-4574.description:
Activate Welding Jar by sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Welding Jar from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Welding Jar from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat.

985-5078-6259.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

2781-6558.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Naga Fleshcrafter.
2781-6558.description:
Cast Naga Fleshcrafter by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Felidar Guardian
When Naga Fleshcrafter enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Felidar Guardian.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Naga Fleshcrafter. Choose to have Naga Fleshcrafter enter the battlefield as a copy of Felidar Guardian.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-1770-4124-5954-6664.description:
Cast Whip Silk by paying {G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Resolve the Whip Silk spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Whip Silk by paying {G}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

654-1479-5700-5701-6662.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
654-1479-5700-5701-6662.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Chocobo Racetrack trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Chocobo Racetrack trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Chocobo Racetrack and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Echoing Deeps.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Chocobo Racetrack trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Chocobo Racetrack triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

488-1414-2478-2895-4986.notablePrerequisites: One of either Lotus Petal or Mishra's Bauble must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
488-1414-2478-2895-4986.description:
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Uro from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Uro enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities and Loran trigger.
Resolve the first Uro trigger, sacrificing it.
Resolve the second Uro trigger, causing you to gain 3 life and draw a card, and allowing you to put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Loran trigger, returning the other {0} cost artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the spell cast in step 1.
Activate the {0} cost artifact by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

413-2018-6288.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Infernal Vessel.
When Infernal Vessel dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Demon in addition to its other types.
When Infernal Vessel enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Infernal Vessel.
When Infernal Vessel dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Infernal Vessel from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
When Infernal Vessel enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5.
Repeat.

101-864-1987-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
101-864-1987-4276.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Eternal Witness and Vampire Charmseeker.
When Eternal Witness and Vampire Charmseeker enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
101-864-1987-4276.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

3967-4186-5445.easyPrerequisites: Tarrian's Soulcleaver attached to Scurry Oak.
3967-4186-5445.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
3967-4186-5445.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the Squirrel.
When the Squirrel dies, Tarrian's Soulcleaver triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 3.

851-1744-3487-5770.description:
Cast Rite of Replication with kicker by paying {7}{U}{U}, creating ten token copies of Aetherstorm Roc.
When the Aetherstorm Roc tokens enter the battlefield, each Aetherstorm Roc you control triggers ten times, causing you to get 110 {E}.
Activate Architect of the Untamed by paying eight {E}, creating a 6/6 Beast artifact creature token.
When the Beast enters the battlefield, each Aetherstorm Roc you control triggers, causing you to get eleven {E}.
Repeat from step 3.

549-4170-4853.notablePrerequisites:
Fain does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
549-4170-4853.description:
Activate Fain's third ability by tapping it and sacrificing an creature, which is an artifact due to Biotransference.
When the creature dies,  Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Fain.
Resolve the Fain ability from step 1, creating a 2/1 Inkling creature token that is an artifact due to Biotransference.
Repeat.

224-1250-1359.notablePrerequisites: You have a land card in hand.
224-1250-1359.description:
Cast Scouting Trek by paying {1}{G}, searching your library for all basic lands in your library and putting them on top.
Play any land.
The land enters the battlefield, triggering Retreat to Coralhelm, causing you to scry 1, ensuring to leave the basic land on top of your library.
Galadriel triggers, causing you to reveal the basic land on top of your library and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
Repeat from step 3.

2450-3009-4445.notablePrerequisites: Leyline Immersion attached to a legendary creature you control without summoning sickness.
2450-3009-4445.description:
Activate the creature with Leyline Immersion attached by tapping it, adding {4}{U} that can only be spent to cast spells.
Cast Whim of Volrath with buyback by paying {2}{U}, targeting Akroan Conscriptor.
Akroan Conscriptor triggers, causing you to untap the creature with Leyline Immersion attached.
Resolve Whim of Volrath, returning it to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use Akroan Conscriptor's ability to untap any other creature(s) you control.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Kiora's Follower and without summoning sickness

116-283-2665.description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Progenitor Mimic.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Kiora's Follower's ability.
Resolve both Kiora's Follower abilities, untapping Progenitor Mimic and another permanent you control.
Activate Progenitor Mimic by tapping it, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

1286-2292-5058.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one other creature.
Screams from Within attached to other creature.
1286-2292-5058.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing enchanted creature.
Screams from Within triggers, returning it from the graveyard to the battlefield attaching to Ajani's Chosen.
Ajani's Chosen triggers, creating a 2/2 Cat token and attach Screams from Within to it.
Resolve the Viscera Seer's ability, scrying one.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with a kick counter on it

249-1173-2160.notablePrerequisites: Zethi does not have summoning sickness.
249-1173-2160.description:
Declare Zethi as an attacker.
Zethi triggers, copying all cards you own in exile with kick counters on them and allowing you to cast the copies.
Cast the Final Fortune copy by paying {R}{R}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and lose the game at the end of the extra turn.
At the beginning of each extra turn's end step, Final Fortune triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sundial of the Infinite by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to end your turn and exile Final Fortune's trigger from the stack.
Repeat each turn.

65-717-881-2628-4477.description:
Activate Scattered Groves's cycling ability by paying {0} and discarding it.
Bone Miser, Scattered Groves, and Escape Protocol trigger.
Resolve the Bone Miser trigger, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Scattered Groves trigger, drawing a card.
Resolve the Escape Protocol trigger, causing you to pay {1} to blink Greenwarden of Murasa.
Greenwarden of Murasa enters the battlefield, returning Scattered Groves from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
